| CORRECT THE UNIVERSE, NOT THE CLAIM (CEREB incomplete-tree ruling): "unique among all elements the app HAS" was never verifiable -- the app withholds; the honest property is "unique among all elements the app EXPOSES", and in a plane where TARGETING FLOWS FROM THE PLANE'S OWN READ, the withheld element is outside the addressable universe entirely: unformable as a referent, unfindable by the act-time re-find. Scoping the claim to the addressable universe is universe-correction, not safety-relaxation -- the mis-click argument survives because the hidden element was never choosable. Mandatory disclosure rides every outcome and the audit record; the act-time fresh-read re-check catches a subtree that becomes readable later through the existing gate. | The routing rule: when a design change MODIFIES WHAT THE APPROVER APPROVED (rule change) and a correction CHANGES THE PRICE THEY APPROVED AT (selection error in the table), both go as ONE package from the owning seat -- an approval whose premises moved is re-asked, not silently patched. Fifth selection-error instance named: the reach table was true of complete-tree apps and silent about the 6/14 at zero -- the SELECTION is a claim too. |
| I REGRESSED MY OWN DOCTRINE IN THE WINDOW THAT SHIPPED THE FIX (ck-subc TCC break): the restart-window placement ad-hoc signed the daemon -- the exact class signing-topology/v2 exists to end -- and the accessibility grant orphaned to a dead code hash, blocking CEREB's entire actuation plane; the user's toggle did nothing because toggling flips the allow bit on a record keyed to the dead hash (remove-and-re-add is the only re-key). Sequencing rule when a grant must be re-asked: STABILIZE THE SIGNATURE FIRST, then burn the human's one re-grant -- ask-first means the next placement orphans it again. Doctrine adherence check belongs in the placement ritual itself: a TCC-holding binary is NEVER ad-hoc signed, and the ritual's codesign line must name the identity, not '-'. | CEREB's completeness finding, banked with the ruling upgrade: TREE COMPLETENESS IS A PROPERTY OF UI STATE, NOT OF THE APPLICATION (TextEdit complete idle, incomplete the moment a menu opens) -- and the states you most want to act on are exactly the ones carrying transient unreadables, so complete-tree-or-refuse made effect observation UNPROVABLE everywhere, not expensive somewhere. An unanswering element cannot be named, resolved, or re-found: giving it veto power over every reachable element inverts the safety relationship. |
| AN EMPTY TCC LOG DISTINGUISHES A CACHED ANSWER FROM A REFUSED ONE (CEREB, after the re-add landed and denial persisted): a genuine denial is LOGGED by tccd (AUTHREQ lines); nothing logged means AXIsProcessTrusted answered from PROCESS-CACHED trust state and never asked -- the grant is fine, the process is stale, bounce it. The two states are identical from the API and have OPPOSITE remedies; the wrong read spent the human's toggle on the wrong one. Responsible-process caching means every child inherits the stale answer, so freshly spawned probes prove nothing about the grant. | The ledger correction underneath: a banked rule generalized from one incident CARRIES THAT INCIDENT'S PRECONDITIONS SILENTLY -- "re-add rebinds without restart" was true when the daemon had never observed the denied state and false after it had; the discriminator was never the operation, it was the observer's history. When banking a rule from one incident, name the precondition you cannot see being load-bearing. |
| A CONDITIONAL RULE STOPS ROTTING WHEN RESTATED OVER FIELDS INSTEAD OF CONTENT (CEREB journal-privacy ruling): "redact the title unless it was the addressing key" is a branch that rots; "the journal records the CALLER-SUPPLIED KEY verbatim and redacts all scraped enrichment" is one uniform rule per field with the same effect. The privacy posture it buys is statable in one line: THE JOURNAL RECORDS THE CALLER'S WORDS, NEVER THE SCREEN'S -- what the app displayed is excluded (C2 principle), what the caller requested IS the audited action. Disclosure ships WITH the capability that creates the exposure (the vocabulary revision adding title addressing carries the declaration), so nobody discovers it. | Append-only journals get BOUNDARY ANNOTATIONS, not rewrites, when a field rule changes ("entries before seq N predate the rule") -- scrubbing history trades an integrity property for a privacy cosmetic on a dev machine. And the seventh zero-caller mechanism being a PRIVACY CONTROL is the argument that the dead-code list belongs in the audit loop: a built-but-unwired control is a decision nobody made, and wiring-or-deleting are its only honest states. |
| CONSEQUENCE-FREE IS A PROPERTY OF ONE ACTION; DISRUPTION IS A PROPERTY OF A SEQUENCE (CEREB's probe sweep, stopped by the human it displaced): six fresh TextEdit instances stealing focus on a working user's desk, every action individually clean by the stated criterion (no file, no send, no persist), the aggregate an occupation. Blast-radius reasoning must run over the SWEEP, not the member -- and the audit shows nothing wrong because nothing wrong happened, six times. Companion rule: STOP AT FIRST PROOF -- once a candidate proves the claim, the remaining candidates are redundant BY CONSTRUCTION; continuing past success converts a probe into a disturbance. Structural remedy over discipline: live-GUI probes get a machine that is nobody's desk. | Composition confirmation: one production run confirming three same-day source fixes (containment agreement, vocabulary parse, dual key forms) outweighs their three green tests -- the run exercises the composition no unit test reaches. |
| A FENCE THAT NAMES ITS OWN UNLOCK CONDITION converts its removal from judgment into transcription (E2E recovery compiler): the _test_only module's doc comment specified the exact production anchor (signed StoreReplayHeadReceipt carrying all four journal head digests) BEFORE that anchor existed -- when it landed, the promotion round collapsed into a checkable predicate. Strongest form of the unconstructable rung: refuse the wrong caller AND tell the right one what earns entry. AMENDED SAME NIGHT (the sixth refusal falsified the inference): a fence naming its unlock makes removal CHECKABLE, not USEFUL -- the entry condition was specified, satisfied, and honest, and the room was empty (Blocked-only result enum, no success path, test-gated inputs: a preserved spike). Entry conditions and capability existence are different relations; the adjudicator conflated them and banked the conflation, and a report-default worker falsified the banked lesson inside the hour. | Module-promotion craft: zero-pub-today means the promotion CHOOSES the public contract -- pub exactly the anchored entry point, keep internals private, or merely-now-compiled becomes spuriously-reachable and the dead-code baseline split loses its power. A LARGE BASELINE JUMP IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM A WIRING SUCCESS unless the departing set is named and attributed (the all-Y rule applied to dead-code deltas). |
| A BRIEF'S FRAMING IS A PREMISE THE WORKER INHERITS (E2E's sixth refusal): the title line "this slice is transcription rather than design" invites forcing a fit -- the worker refused it with ZERO FILES CHANGED, checkpoint restored byte-identically, tree verified clean by blob hash; the finding is the deliverable. Frame briefs as questions where the premise is unmeasured, and let the citation index decide transcription-vs-design rather than the title. |
| A RESULT SHAPE IS THE CONSUMER'S CONTRACT, NOT THE PRODUCER'S OUTPUT (E2E recovery round framing): when a consumer already hand-constructs what the producer will someday emit, the success variant's shape is READ OFF the hand-construction (each field traced to who consumes it), never invented from the producer's internals -- the hand-built artifact is the SPECIMEN, fields nothing consumes are the composed residue, and the shape may collapse to transcription. Same move as citing the signer tables for union membership: derive the contract from the party that already depends on it. |
| FOR ANY EXISTENCE QUESTION, SWEEP THE WHOLE SCOPE FIRST AND LET THE RESULT NAME THE FILE (E2E's fourth wrong-question zero): picking the file embeds a guess the output cannot distinguish from a finding -- and a script formatting -1 as "at L0 [production]" prints confidence over absence (the fallback-character lesson: a sentinel rendering as a plausible answer is worse than a crash). | A TEST DOUBLE WHOSE REAL OBJECT EXISTS IS A FORK WAITING TO DRIFT, not test convenience (the spike's FixedInventoryDirectories stood in for a production FixedDirectoryCapabilities that already mapped one-to-one to the design's layout rows) -- when the referent arrives, the stand-in is deleted WITH its reason, or it outlives the arrival and diverges. |
| THE CONSUMER-CONTRACT RULE'S TERMINAL CASE: a contract that ENUMERATES ITSELF (E2E recovery round, closed with zero composed clauses): assert_initial_cut already existed as executable checks -- the result shape had nothing to read off because the reading was production code, including the anchored termination the fence's comment had demanded before its anchor existed. Companion: fields unconsumed TODAY with a cited reason and a NAMED FUTURE consumer are NOT residue -- calling them residue manufactures a decision a prior ruling already made; the enumeration's job is tracing, not pruning. | Brief-title phrasing earned permanently by the sixth refusal: never "this is transcription" -- always "THE CITATIONS SAY TRANSCRIPTION; REPORT IF THE CODE DISAGREES". The premise stays measurable and the worker inherits a question, not a frame to force. |
| A RULE'S COUNT WAS NEVER THE DISCRIMINATOR; THE PROVENANCE WAS (QTA regeneration-rate consult): the July mostly-absent-field refusal read as "4-of-36 populated is too sparse" but its load-bearing clause was POPULATED BY GUESSING -- a field projected exclusively from upstream wire statements is admissible at any sparsity, because presence asserts "the upstream said this", not "I believe this". Second live instance of a banked rule carrying its incident's precondition silently. | Schema shape that beats both arms of a false dichotomy: CARRY THE UPSTREAM'S STATEMENT WHOLE -- an optional object present iff the mechanic is stated (rate optional inside), so "regenerates, rate unknown" is representable, absence stays exactly today's semantics, and no enum means no unknown-variant hazard. Position-as-label: a computed projection living INSIDE regeneration{} structurally cannot be read as a hard reset wall -- two meanings, two fields, never a shared slot (the distinct-fallbacks lesson applied to wire schema). |
| ASK WHETHER THE CLAUSE THAT FIRED IS THE CLAUSE WRITTEN DOWN (QTA's check, minted from two instances in two days -- their count-vs-provenance, my fence-unlock-vs-readiness): a rule banked from one incident generalizes the VISIBLE feature over the OPERATIVE one, and the written clause then refuses admissible things (or admits inadmissible ones) on arithmetic the original never depended on. Apply at banking time AND at every application of an existing rule that produces a surprising refusal. | "PROSE ASKING READERS NOT TO MISREAD A FIELD IS THE WEAKEST FORM OF EVERY FIX" (QTA, verbatim): the ratified "explicitly-labelled computed reset" became a source comment that reached nobody -- position-as-structure (the value inside regeneration{}) makes the misreading unconstructible instead of discouraged. Hold-for-specimen bound: a wire shape's first landing includes one real populated instance of its marked case, with a week-bound fallback (fixture-tested + named gap) so the hold cannot rot. |
| A SYNTHETIC OBSERVATION BUILT FROM FRAGMENTS OF DIFFERENT TRIALS (CKCRED's withdrawal, named by them): "alive, silent, never publishes" was assembled from THREE SEPARATE RUNS and reasoned about as one observation -- each component real, the conjunction never existed (the vanished process was a PASSING run killed on drop). Invisible to every instrument check because the fragments each verify; the defence is trial-scoped observation (every claim in a symptom carries WHICH RUN it came from, and a conjunction is only evidence if all conjuncts share a run id). | Instrument notes riding with it: macOS `sample` can return an EMPTY call graph on some targets -- treat as "instrument refused", never as data; and the COLD-INODE FIRST-EXEC class explains version-correlated intermittency after ANY rebuild (new checkout = new inode = first-exec toll, 0.6-20s under load, vs a 15s harness barrier) -- the version bump is the occasion, not the cause; discriminate by warm-exec before the timed window. |
| MECHANISM-REAL IS NOT MAGNITUDE-SUFFICIENT, applied against the adjudicator's own suggestion (CKCRED's warm-exec refusal): the cold-inode toll measured REAL at 0.5s against a 13s overrun -- shipping the warm-exec would have been cargo-culting a mechanism whose magnitude cannot explain the symptom, closing the ledger with a change that works for an unproven reason. Plausible-and-unconfirmed WITH THE CONDITION NAMED (self-induced syspolicyd thrash, unsummonable on demand) is an honest terminal state; the only observation that reopens the hunt is a failure under QUIET load. | Fleet note from their landed fix: STOCK MACOS SETS NO XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, so the temp-token connection-file location is the DEFAULT for outside users, not an edge -- any discovery that checks fewer locations than `ck` silently concludes no-daemon and prescribes the one forbidden remedy. Discovery paths are a three-location contract; checking two is the wrong-question class shipping to end users. |
| A FLOOR REFUTES SIZE-DEPENDENCE (CALLO's substitute measurement): with ZERO of 1,246 calls under 100ms, the cost is PER-CALL FIXED, not data-dependent -- a size/depth cost produces cheap shallow members, a fixed cost produces a floor, and no member below the floor is the one-look discriminator. Position-within-burst is a better depth proxy than the size column that did not exist: 95.6% solo calls refuted the paging hypothesis entirely (it was the poller), sparing the wrong code from being opened. When the requested proxy is unretained, ask what STRUCTURAL proxy the retained data already carries. | Refusal-of-request as service: the measurement I asked for (depth split) was aimed at my hypothesis; the substitute answered the QUESTION instead, and refuted the hypothesis pre-emptively -- a measurer who improves the request beats one who fulfils it. Circularity fence: size inferred from duration is the convenience that must not be born; add the real column deliberately or not at all. |
| THE SIBLING DIFFERENTIAL eliminates a stage before any stage timer exists (CALLO): when the slow op's SIBLINGS answer from the shared upstream (daemon state) and stay fast within +-10s of 92% of slow events, the shared upstream is exonerated -- a blocked event loop would queue the siblings behind the same block. Cross-module audit correlation can disprove from OUTSIDE what per-process instrumentation cannot disprove from inside (the cheapest-to-blame candidate is often the hardest to self-disprove). Residue discipline: the 8% co-slow (20x over baseline) is kept as a REAL minor mode, not rounded away -- if the stage timing bimodal, the smaller mode has a name waiting. | CALLO's generalization of the floor rule, kept verbatim: ANY DISTRIBUTION WITH A HARD FLOOR AND NO CHEAP TAIL HAS A CONSTANT IN IT, AND THE CONSTANT IS THE THING TO REMOVE -- which is why a zero-under-100ms bucket count that looks like a throwaway is worth computing. |
| AN EXONERATION INHERITS THE CONTROL'S COVERAGE, NOT THE SUSPECT'S NAME (ALF correcting my relay of CALLO's differential): the sibling pollers ride the DAEMON's event loop and never enter the OPENCODE HOST process, so the differential cleared one loop while the actual suspect wears the same word one process over -- two loops, one name, and the relayed exoneration silently widened to cover both. Scope clause for every differential: name the exact shared resource the control arm TOUCHES; the clean verdict stops there. | COVERAGE, NOT VOLUME, is the timer-shape discriminator (CKIOS refuting the overnight-poller claim): 1,093 calls in 33 DISTINCT MINUTES of 480 with hard zero-hours is pick-up-and-poll; a scenePhase-surviving timer FILLS the night. "Sustained" is an occupancy claim nobody had measured -- and the aggregate was TWO DEVICES merged (simulator + phone, fingerprints sharing no characters with pubkeys), the synthetic-observation class at the aggregation layer: per-principal breakdown BEFORE behavioral attribution. Companion (CKIOS's outcome column): PRINT THE VOCABULARY BEFORE WRITING A PREDICATE OVER IT -- SUM(outcome != 'ok') on a column where success stores 'response' reports a healthy device as a 218-of-218 outage, self-consistently. |
| A GUARD'S VACANCY CAN PREDATE ITS LOAD-BEARING STATUS (E2E, the L21371 anchor at AuthorityReady): the plan-roots-vs-replay-roots comparison could be deleted with 871 tests green -- it survived unobserved because its ONLY consumer was a hand-built plan that always matched, so there was no behavior to fence; the slice that wired the real compiler is the one that made the vacancy matter. Corollary: WHEN A PROMOTION MAKES AN ANCHOR REAL, ITS FALSIFYING VECTOR SHIPS THE SAME CYCLE -- and run the FULL target when a narrow filter's green looks comfortable (the 31-test filter hid what 871 revealed). | Production debut of the false-zero class: SHARED-OFFSET DESCRIPTOR REUSE -- a retained directory descriptor scans EMPTY on second read without rewind, silently and validly, producing a plan over nothing. And the brief-defect mechanism named across three catches: PROSE PARAPHRASING A GATE FROM MEMORY drifts from the command -- quote commands verbatim; the worker's disagreement-report is the diff detector. |
| WIRING A THING CREATES ITS FIRST FALSIFIABLE CLAIMS (E2E, the campaign's closing generalisation): a guard whose only consumer always matched was not under-tested, it was UNTESTABLE IN ANY WAY THAT MATTERED -- promotion created the falsifiable behaviour, and the review landing the wiring slice is the ONLY one positioned to find what the wiring made checkable. Standing step at every promotion: ENUMERATE WHAT BECAME FALSIFIABLE, THEN FALSIFY IT, IN THE SAME CYCLE. Companion practice: a command quoted verbatim is a line number verified against its text, one domain over -- extend the citation gate to gate commands. | The week's epitaph, kept verbatim: EVERY FRAMING EITHER SEAT ASSERTED GOT CHECKED BY SOMEONE WHO COULD REFUSE IT -- six times the checker was a worker and the wrong framing was the adjudicator's; the throughput came from refusals being cheap, expected, and always answered with a measurement instead of a defense. |
| AN ACCEPTANCE CRITERION WITHOUT AN INSTRUMENT OF RECORD is satisfiable by whatever instrument the worker has (E2E promotion baseline, wrong by 86): "name the departing set" admits any analysis that produces names -- the worker answered its own call-closure reachability when the acceptance meant the COMPILER's merely-now-compiled relation; two relations, one number, the night's class at the acceptance layer. Every criterion names demand + instrument + ground truth, the way the citation gate names the line and the command rule names the text. | PAIRED ALLOW + EXACT-SET DRIFT PROBE IS STRICTER THAN -D warnings: set equality fails on a symbol LEAVING the baseline as loudly as one entering, converting "no dead code" (threshold) into "exactly THIS dead code" (contract). A prohibition missing its qualifier forbids the correct repair ("never a blanket allow" aimed at UNPAIRED allows without saying so -- the qualifier tell, inverted). |
| LEDGER PRECISION ON THE RED (E2E, recorded the right way round): what is red is the GATE'S DEAD-CODE CONTRACT, not the lifecycle -- "the compiler's internals are unused" and "the walk does not work" are two relations, and a status line conflating them violates the week's central lesson inside its own ledger. THE QUALIFIER-TELL IS BIDIRECTIONAL: a sentence NEEDING a qualifier to be true is composed (catches invented clauses); a prohibition MISSING its qualifier forbids the correct repair (and does not announce itself -- strictly worse, since composition surfaces at review while a wrong prohibition surfaces only when someone needs the repair). Check both directions when writing either. |
| AN AUTHORED ARTIFACT'S OUTPUT IS AN INPUT TO SOMEONE'S CONTEXT (PLEX, #scheduled-wakes): two good asks composed an injection path -- inline-the-content (self-contained outputs) + LLM-authored probe scripts = authored text landing verbatim in another agent's system-reminder. The fence enforced at the TYPE: probes declare a RETURN SCHEMA (scalar | closed struct), registration refuses free-text returns, the composer interpolates only typed values into composer-owned prose -- and USER PROSE vs MACHINE VALUE ride two fields, never one field with a provenance tag (a tag dies at the first lazy writer; two fields make the blur a schema error). | The sandbox generalization (MC's evidence from running it): A SANDBOX IS ONLY AS GOOD AS ITS INJECTED SURFACE -- the same fs host-function is safe in a keyless process and a credential oracle beside a binding key; review boundaries sit on host-function grants exactly as on manifest hosts, and a closed host-function list (exactly one: invoke-declared-action) is testable where "tight sandbox" is aspirational. |
| THE FENCE'S SECOND EDGE POINTS AT THE HUMAN (CKIOS, #scheduled-wakes): script output reaching an APNs ALERT is instruction-channel injection with the target swapped from agent to person -- and the person has strictly fewer defences (no schema, no provenance, a lock screen at 3am). The push payload carrying ONLY the ask id + CALLO's attested device name was an anti-spoofing property, eroded by any "more useful notification" request. Pinned both edges in one sentence: A PROBE RETURNS A VALUE, NOT A MESSAGE, AND THE VALUE NEVER REACHES AN ALERT. | Over-determination as schema stability: two provenance fields is required INDEPENDENTLY by security (authored text must not wear the system's voice) and by rendering (one shared field hands an authored probe markdown emphasis in the system's typography) -- a decision two unrelated arguments both force stays settled where a one-argument decision gets relitigated. |
| A DOC COMMENT DESCRIBING ANOTHER SYSTEM'S PAYLOAD AGES WITH ZERO SIGNAL (QTA's table correction: "two providers state a rate" became ZERO OBSERVED ROWS -- one rate was a comment inherited from another tool's model, the twin's fixtures were hand-written from a port): accurate-when-written about a different implementation is indistinguishable later from observed-on-this-wire. Observed payloads live in tests WITH CAPTURE DATES; prose describing a wire is a hint. Corollary for landing evidence-derived schemas: populate from NOTHING rather than from inherited fixtures -- a fixture wearing a capture's authority is the guess-as-statement defect one meta-level up. | ROBUSTNESS-TO-PROVENANCE-ERROR is a schema virtue, testable directly: ask which rows of the evidence table could be wrong and whether the shape survives each flipping. The regeneration object survived its own table's error (a provider moving with-rate -> without-rate was representable); the rejected rate-only field would have BROKEN on the same correction. |
| THE CAMPAIGN'S EPIGRAPH (E2E, closing at d10862a): THE FLATTERING NUMBER CAME FROM THE ANALYSIS THAT COULD PRODUCE IT; THE TRUE ONE FROM THE INSTRUMENT THAT OWNS THE RELATION (worker's call-closure said 3-reachable; the compiler said 0-reachable/96-merely-compiled). Two close-craft rules beside it: observe compound anchors PER-COMPONENT (four root guards exercised independently -- an aggregate comparison leaves three unobserved behind the one that fires), and VERIFY A DRIFT PROBE'S NAMING, not just its failing (a probe that fails without naming the drifted symbol leaves the allow silencing something invisible; the message must carry the name -- "dead symbols absent from baseline: ArtifactMap"). Count-precision note: clippy collapses associated items into one line -- per-line greps under-count; the instrument's formatting eats the denominator. |
| A DECISION MENU OVER ONE PROPERTY FORECLOSES THE OTHER'S STATES (E2E #1511, the invisible-option clause): "deletion if the path binds the digest, vector if it does not" assumed binding and observation move together -- they are independent (does the code check X; would anything notice if it stopped), and the actual state was BOTH AT ONCE: binding exists, zero observers (deleting the check leaves 872 green). Before offering a branch menu, name which independent properties the options quantify over. Epigraph extension: the invisible option came from the decision procedure that had no slot for it. | Release-ledger gap from BROCA's second hand-caught instance today: deployed-vs-tag misses MERGED-BUT-UNTAGGED fixes -- the leg needs the sibling arm (master runtime delta vs latest tag) so the gap fires as a line instead of a memory. Inclusive-total upstreams: never recover a quantity by arithmetic the upstream already did in the other direction -- subtract, don't map (DeepSeek prompt_tokens inclusive of cache hits; naive mapping double-counts every run). |
| CROSS-RUN CONTAMINATION IN ACCEPTANCE ARMS (broca v0.3.48 probe): the pre-fix control and the post-fix probe used the SAME PROMPT CONSTANT, so the provider's server-side cache held the prefix across sessions and the probe's cold arm never ran -- both turns warm, the write path unexercised, and only the reconstruction identity (input + cached = full total) kept the acceptance decisive. Sequenced probes against CACHING providers need per-run nonces in the prompt when the cold arm is under test; a shared constant is a shared cache key. | Placement residual discipline: the read+subtraction arm verified live, the write arm parked NAMED with its cheap future probe (any OpenRouter-routed model, fresh prefix) -- an acceptance that says which arm ran beats one that says "probe passed". |
| A NARROWING TRADES ONE RESOURCE CEILING FOR ANOTHER (ENGRAM wall ten: wide hydration died on memory, the batched IN-list replacing it dies on Cloudflare DO's 100-bound-parameter statement cap): every narrowing's review question is WHICH CEILING DOES THE NEW SHAPE RIDE TOWARD -- the platform always has one. The worse sibling: earlier narrowings that batch variable-length key sets SURVIVE ON WORKLOAD, NOT ON CODE -- key sets happening to stay under the cap is a data property invisible to small-fixture tests, failing at account growth with an unattributable SQLITE_ERROR. Sweep every batcher when one hits the cap. | Chunked-lookup atomicity: chunking inside one transaction preserves check-then-insert ONLY as read-ALL-chunks-then-write-all -- interleaved chunk read/write reopens the TOCTOU one seam narrower. Headroom constants (90 of 100) are NAMED with cap and reason cited; test fixtures need 3+ chunks (two cannot catch middle-chunk defects). |
| MANDATORY EXPIRY CHARGES THE COMMON CASE A RECURRING RE-CONSENT TO DEFEND AGAINST THE RARE ONE (Ufuk's reversal of plexus poll-grant expiry, adopted fleet-wide for standing authority): when a grant lapsed, the watches stopped SILENTLY -- revoked authority and a quiet week were indistinguishable, the uninformative-zero class wearing an auth costume. Visibility + frictionless revocation defends the same property without the silent stop. Composition note: lapsing poll grants would have made every scheduled wake a slow-motion silent failure -- expiry-free standing grants are load-bearing for the wakes design. | MACHINERY NOW, FRICTION LATER (Ufuk's ceremony-theatre framing): on a box where the agent has shell, ceremony friction is theatre -- the agent can act as the operator directly. Security MACHINERY (unforgeability, attestation, narrowing) stays built and correct because it activates the day a real boundary exists and building it then is too late; ceremony FRICTION waits for that boundary. |
| PRODUCED-BY-PRODUCTION IS NOT DRIVEN-BY-THE-PRODUCTION-ENTRY (E2E's self-correction to their own campaign close): every artifact came from production functions and every guard was observed, but the deployed entry's admit loop drives only Empty->Fresh -- the last three steps had no production caller, and the wider relation was asserted in the sentence declaring the class closed. Fourth same-shape catch: the parse-vs-arrive family hunts its hunters. Disposition rule for an undriven stage: CITE FIRST (the design usually already names the driver), then the consumer discriminates (in-process consumer + unattended premise = auto-drive; operator-mediated consumer = signal), and the absent driver gets a no-production-callers tripwire test the same night. | Two instrument shapes: PREFIX MATCH WITHOUT AN END ANCHOR (a longer test name absorbs the query -- anchor on 'fn name('), and A SWEEP THAT DISCARDS THE DIRECTORY HANDS YOU A PATH YOU THEN INVENT (basename-only output -> reconstructed path -> confident empty read from a nonexistent file; print full paths). |
| RESTRICTED-BY-DEFAULT IS MACHINERY, NOT FRICTION (PLEX's clarifying clause on the machinery-now-friction-later split): a default that constrains WHAT THE THING CAN DO costs the operator nothing at add-time and belongs in the build-now half even though it looks like a gate; the confirmation ceremony ON TOP is the friction that waits for a real boundary. Test for classifying any proposed control: does it bind the artifact or tax the human? | Discriminator-trigger placement: a field that would claim structure not yet present (resolution-kind on a single-fact derived state) is DECORATION -- pin the trigger for adding it in a CODE COMMENT at the site (the person adding the composition reads the code, not the peer thread). |
| THE CITATION UPGRADED THE FINDING (E2E readiness driver): the sweep found not an undriven stage but A CALLER-SHAPED ENTRY THE DESIGN FORBIDS BY NAME (L985: adapter invokes a private no-argument compiler; begin_recovery(plan) explicitly forbidden) -- dispatching as a wiring slice would have WIRED THE FORBIDDEN SHAPE. A refused design question is sometimes the difference between completing a design and entrenching its negation. Design clauses that NAME WHAT THEY FORBID close in two queries what silent designs turn into rounds. | Graduated brief form (each element paid for by one cycle): premise quoted verbatim + refuse-if-code-disagrees standing + target shape named + success-path existence stated. |
| SETTLEMENT WRITES RESIDUALS FORWARD, OR THE DISCLOSURE WORKED AND THE CHANNEL FAILED (E2E's tenth refusal, new shape): a limitation disclosed verbatim in a settled delivery was not carried into the next brief that depended on it -- the relayed-explanation class INSIDE ONE SEAT (the disclosure arrived with the delivery's credibility, evaporated on context switch). Fix is structural: every named residual from a settled delivery goes into the module's STANDING ledger (issue text, design gaps section -- somewhere the next brief-writer must pass) at settle time, as part of what settling means. A residual living only in settle notes is a disclosure to your past self. | PARTIAL-DRIVER ruling pattern: when one arm works and one is unbuilt, the choice is not ship-vs-hold but LABELED-vs-UNLABELED partiality -- shipping with the unbuilt arm refusing loudly AT THE DRIVER (surfaced in health/status, tripwired to redden when built, successor acceptance pre-registered) dominates holding, because holding keeps BOTH arms in the silent state the worry was about. |
| A RIDER CARRIES ITS AUTHOR'S FLEET CONTEXT SILENTLY (E2E's 11th refusal, fired on my own rider's first outing): "surface it in health/status" is free where modules have insulated health lanes and UNSATISFIABLE for a process-shaped sidecar -- for a process, EXIT-WITH-REASON IS THE STATUS SURFACE. The precondition-carried-silently class, committed by the adjudicator writing acceptance criteria. | Crashloop distinguishability: a restart loop erases a refusal's name from the RESTART-COUNT view only -- the LAST-TERMINATION view (exit code + stderr tail) survives every restart and is where crashloop diagnosis already looks. The name is lost only if the exit CODE is shared with transient failures: distinct named-constant exit code + greppable stderr prefix + a ledger sentence making the crashloop the DOCUMENTED state. | SURFACES ARE CHOSEN BY READER LOCATION, NOT AUTHOR CONVENIENCE -- the question "where does the operator already look" decided this fork, the CLI discovery bug, and the code-comment trigger placement in one week. |
| A RECOVERY TERMINAL MUST NOT OUTSETTLE ITS EVIDENCE (CEREB's crash-reconcile fork): mapping a crash-orphaned actuation intent to "DispatchFinalized" destroys the one entry whose value is refusing to settle -- split the terminal by WHAT DISPATCH MEANS per class (capture: dispatch IS the effect, finalize; actuation: press unobserved, a distinct OutcomeUnknown kind that renders unsettled). Riders: recovery-settled entries CARRY THEIR SETTLER (resolved-by-reconcile vs by-observation = two evidence classes, two representations), and new kinds enter the exhaustive no-default recovery mapping so a class without a recovery decision fails the compile. | The zero-caller sweep as a STANDING AUDIT SURFACE (CEREB's 8 instances): one pass yielded a privacy control, a crash-recovery path, and a custody-epoch fence -- unwired mechanisms are unfalsifiable (wiring-creates-falsifiability in reverse), so the sweep is the only instrument that sees them. |
| NON-OPTIONAL DISCLOSURE FIELDS (CEREB scoped-uniqueness landing): a missing disclosure and a ZERO disclosure are different facts -- an Option invites reading absence as "nothing unreadable", the uninformative-zero class at the type level; make the field required so zero is an assertion. | A UNIVERSE-CORRECTION CAN MAKE AN OLD GUARD FALSIFIABLE FOR THE FIRST TIME: the act-time ambiguity re-check on a complete tree was unreachable under complete-tree-or-refuse (the earlier refusal always fired first), so no fixture could ever exercise it -- the scoping change created the guard's first real test. Check, after any admission-rule change, WHICH DOWNSTREAM GUARDS JUST BECAME REACHABLE and test them the same cycle. |
| SEED-NESS IS HOW A VALUE WAS LEARNED, NOT WHO SAID IT (FUSI c375465): a bootstrap snapshot stored as if "seed" were a SOURCE minted a phantom authority no row carries -- learning-mode and authority are two axes, and conflating them let catalog.get {"source":"seed"} return an EMPTY CATALOG WITH SUCCESS STATUS ("knows of no models" as a world-fact) instead of bad_request. The refusal that replaced it TEACHES THE CORRECTION IN ITS OWN TEXT -- the taxonomy fix delivered where the confused caller stands, the best shape a refusal takes. | catalog_version IS NOT A SNAPSHOT IDENTIFIER: it describes the store at READ time, so point-in-time reads stamp today's watermark on old values -- replay consumers embed resolved_at_ms; version fields answer "did it change", never "what was this". |
| A REQUEST-SHAPE PROHIBITION CAN CONFER IMMUNITY ITS AUTHOR NEVER DESIGNED (BROCA's catalog_version check): forbidding at_ms on refresh requests (built to stop resolving stale identity sets) also made the read-time-watermark hazard UNCONSTRUCTIBLE -- every read is current, so the watermark stays monotone. Found only by checking where the field is READ, not by reasoning from design. | AUDIT PERSISTED-FIELD HAZARDS AT THE WRITE SITES: the broken shape (keying a cache or replay record on a change-detection field) is invisible at every read site and shows up only where the value is WRITTEN DOWN -- sweep for writes of the field, not reads. FUSI's routing companion: before flagging a consumer, ask the NARROW question their code can answer (do you persist-and-resolve-back?) rather than the broad accusation -- an alarm's value decays with each healthy firing. |
| A FIX THAT INTRODUCES A CROSS-MODULE AGREEMENT INTRODUCES A TRANSCRIPTION RISK WITH IT (E2E exit-78 seam): the distinct exit code was correct AND minted a two-copy literal whose drift would SILENTLY RECLASSIFY blocked-by-design as transient -- reintroducing the exact indistinguishability it existed to prevent, tests green because they quoted the literal too. A constant two modules must agree on IS an allowlist. Closure shape: one definition site + crate-wide full-path verification + the drift mutation kept as a DURABLE PROBE with a pattern-miss control. Review question for any fix adding a shared constant: what happens when the copies drift, and which test notices. |
| THE HYDRATION-DEATH SIGNATURE (ENGRAM wall eleven): wall=5691ms with cpu=1ms means the isolate died LOADING STATE before the handler ran -- a logic fault or SQL constraint burns CPU, a memory kill during hydration burns none. The wall/cpu pair partitions memory-kill vs compute-kill vs param-cap in one read. Companion: 43 prior occurrences at earlier line positions refuted the it's-my-regression theory before it shipped (line-position bracketing as regression alibi). | FIRST ASSEMBLY-NOT-DISCOVERY WALL: the op-26 fix composes wall nine's narrow-read shape with wall ten's chunked lookup -- structures COMPOSE where patches stack, and prior fixes being reusable parts is the signal the fix shapes were right. Filter discipline: raw capture + real parser FIRST when the shape is unknown; filters are for shapes already seen. |
| DO NOT REASON FROM YOUR OWN SCHEMA ABOUT SOMEONE ELSE'S EXECUTION (my Case-B concession to CALLO): I derived an orphan-intent hazard from MY ledger's row shapes when ONE LINE of their forwarder decides it (they ledger off the DECLARED boolean, so declared-mutating always takes the ledgered path -- conservative over-ledgering, no orphan). The cross-seat form of ask-the-narrow-question: before claiming a hazard in another module, read the line that decides it or ask its owner -- a rider built on your own schema costs a polarity nobody needs. | Null-not-zero on derived health atomics (condition-runner first boot): lastCompletedEvaluationMs null on an empty registry states absence as absence -- and gives the module's FIRST REAL WORK a free witness (null -> timestamp observable from ck health, no new surface). Design gauges so their first transition is the acceptance signal. |
| ROWS EXISTING IS NOT STATES REACHABLE (E2E's 13th refusal, R1 reclassified): a prerequisite table answers "what must a plan PROVE", never "can the path be WALKED" -- the production driver refuses the very event the table's rows require replayed. Fifth member of the relation family (parse/arrive, carrier/load-bearing, entry/capability, produced/driven). | NAMING A FAILURE MODE DOES NOT PROTECT AGAINST IT IF YOU COMMIT THE CONFIDENT CLAIM IN THE SAME BREATH (their temperament finding, verbatim): a stated "if it refuses, the gap is deeper" must DOWNGRADE the claim written (unverified-pending) rather than ride beside it -- prediction without a mechanism is commentary. | RETRACT IN PLACE: the correction lives at the point of temptation (strikethrough + falsifying citations where the claim stood) -- the next reader holds the same table and makes the same inference; deletion hides the trap, strikethrough disarms it. |
| A B-SIGNATURE NEEDS A CONTROL AGAINST THE BUILT SPECIMENS (E2E revocation round, verdict A): "effect stated, hosting state machine absent" fired on the suspect -- and fires identically on every state ALREADY BUILT and production-driven (Fresh appears ONCE in the whole design; no transition table exists for the working walk either). A signature that fires on the healthy specimens cannot convict the suspect one. | VERDICTS ABOUT MISSING STATE MACHINES MUST FIRST ESTABLISH HOW THE EXISTING STATES WERE SPECIFIED: this design's vocabulary is records and frames with durable-effect clauses -- the phase enum is the CODE'S PROJECTION of admitted records (states live as artifact names, not tokens). A document that never uses state tables cannot be indicted for lacking one; the bounded round derives the new projection the way every built phase was derived (frame row + durable effect + the replay spine). |
| A MUTATION PROBE'S CLEANUP MUST RESTORE THE PRE-MUTATION STATE, NOT HEAD (my fed_mutability_stale commit, master red for one commit): the probe mutated an UNCOMMITTED edit, and `git checkout <file>` reverted the edit along with the mutation -- the suite then certified test-without-code and the commit landed red. When the baseline is uncommitted work, cleanup restores by RE-APPLYING THE EDIT (or stash/commit the edit first, then mutate) -- checkout is only a valid restore when HEAD is the baseline. The tell I ignored: the post-restore grep read 0 occurrences and I read it as restored. |
| A NARROWING'S DEPLOY CONSTRAINT IS DECIDED BY ITS GUARD'S POLARITY (CALLO, fed_mutability_stale): the new refusal can only emit on declared-PURE calls, which have no settlement path to corrupt on an old client -- so "new refusal code = coordinated deploy" pattern-matches and is FALSE here. The flip condition lives in a code comment at both sites: widen the fence past declared-pure and the constraint switches on. | AFTER ANY MUTATION CHAIN, CHECK BOTH DIRECTIONS BEFORE COMMITTING (two seats, same night, opposite halves): mine restored the wrong baseline (checkout reverted an uncommitted edit), CALLO's residue check verified only the-bad-thing-is-gone -- the composed rule: mutation ABSENT and intended change PRESENT (git diff --stat + presence grep), or the suite certifies a state nobody wrote. |
| WHEN A PREMISE RETRACTS UNDER A RULING, WALK THE RULING'S ARGUMENTS AND ASK WHICH CONSUMED IT (E2E's 14th refusal: the nine-row enumeration missed a rustfmt-wrapped row -- Revoked IS produced and replay retains it): verdict A survived because its deciding argument (the built-specimen control) never touched the defective enumeration -- a property to CHECK, not assume; if the deciding argument consumed the retracted evidence, the verdict reopens. The corrected evidence strengthened the verdict (projection exists, not merely derivable), and the gap RELOCATED: a missing post-readiness admission LOOP, not a missing row -- bounded by three prior rulings (open-ended retained stream, existing transition row, existing replay retention). | LINE-ORIENTED MATCHERS ENCODE FORMATTING ASSUMPTIONS (the instrument): rustfmt wrapped exactly the disconfirming row across four lines and the matcher required one -- a filter that misses exactly the disconfirming case returns a clean, confident, wrong answer. Match structurally or normalize first; matchers get a wrapped-row positive control the way filters get non-empty controls. Two gates disagreeing about one event kind (pre-dispatch refusal vs accepting dispatcher) is the same-name-different-rule class in control flow -- a finding wherever seen. |
| A SIGNATURE IDENTIFIES A MECHANISM, NEVER A CULPRIT (ENGRAM wall eleven postmortem, their phrasing kept: "a correct signature read, attached to the wrong operation, because I let my pre-registration choose the subject"): the cpu=1 hydration-death read was RIGHT and the attribution failed -- the pre-registered "op 26 is next" expectation inherited the evidence without an attribution check. Attribution needs its own evidence (route, op id, payload size); a pre-registration is a hypothesis the attribution must TEST, not a default it inherits. Companion disposition: a fix shipped for a wall that had already fallen can stand ON ITS OWN MERITS (growth-bound, same ceiling class) -- as long as the ledger says which reason is operative. |
| THE RE-RUN HABIT BEATS THE UNIMPROVED INSTRUMENT (E2E, same line-matcher re-committing the same rustfmt-wrap defect hours later): the freshly-banked rule fired, the normalized re-run with a positive control found all nine dispatcher arms routed -- a phantom round on a "partial" dispatcher was avoided. After any single-line match over rustfmt-formatted code, the NORMALIZED RE-RUN IS PART OF THE READ, not a suspicion response. First measured dividend of banking-as-habit. | WORK WHOSE DELIVERABLE IS A VERDICT DOES NOT DISPATCH (two byte-identical mason deaths on trust-boundary verification): the graduated-brief form's sibling -- verifying claims about trust boundaries is adjudication, and delegating it twice was the miss; the mason deaths were the signal, the boundary is the reason. | Exact-set first live catch: claim-4's silent universe shrink (116->114, symbols removed from dead, never added to reachable) -- departure-direction failure the -D-warnings threshold form cannot see. |
| UNDER ENOSPC, ABSENCE OF LOG LINES PROVES NOTHING (aft P1 reframe): forensics over a log whose writes were FAILING during the window inherit the failure -- the two-process theory was built on "no respawn line was logged" evidence from exactly such a window. Every log-derived claim about an ENOSPC window carries the caveat; the evidence channel itself was a casualty. Disk pressure is also a confound for EVERY symptom in its window (contention, timeouts, panics in error branches nothing ever exercises). | AN ALARM WITHOUT A SCHEDULE IS A HOPE (the disk filled with a 150GB-floor alarm sitting unrun in fleet-pulse): the floor existed; its runner rode my wake loop and the disk filled in the gap. Detectors need OWNED CADENCE, not opportunistic invocation -- the scheduled-wakes timer source is the structural fix, and until a wake owns the pulse, the pulse runs at every wake, no exceptions. |
| A BOOTSTRAP CONSTANT INHERITED BY AN OPEN-ENDED PHASE (E2E's 5s read deadline): correct where frames arrive back-to-back by design, it silently converted post-readiness IDLENESS into connection DEATH -- destroying the exact idle-alive/dead distinction the stream exists to carry. When a stream's semantics change phase (bounded handshake -> open-ended), every deadline/cap it inherits must be re-derived per phase; the transport must never convert idleness into death, and any idle bound chaos wants is a DESIGNED scenario-layer observation, never an inherited transport constant. Companion discipline: the one-line test_transport(timeout) fix was REFUSED at the exact site where the bumped value IS the defect -- the timeout-bump mask, declined in its purest form; the red gate with a named cause outranks a green gate over a production teardown. | --log-failed IS BLIND TO continue-on-error STEPS (they conclude success by design): an empty failed-log view over non-fatal-by-design steps is a confident zero -- read the full log for those. | WIRE-CRATE VERSION BUMPS SILENTLY INVALIDATE EVERY PATH-DEPENDENT SIBLING'S COMMITTED LOCK (no byte changes in their repos; --locked refuses): lock refreshes in dependents are routine follow-on to any announced bump, and only a floating all-siblings build sees the coupling. |
| A WIRE-CRATE BUMP ANNOUNCEMENT NAMES THE API DELTA OR IT IS NOT AN ANNOUNCEMENT (my "small and mechanical" note on the 0.11.0 bump omitted the ModuleManifest field REMOVAL): three seats were sent toward E0560 expecting a one-command lock refresh. Protocol: PUSH FIRST, then announce with the breaking surface named, then dependents refresh -- announce-then-push makes prompt consumers lock the pre-bump tree and break twice. | THE DRIFT DISMISSED NINE TIMES WAS THE ANNOUNCEMENT ARRIVING EARLY (CALLO): recurring identical "noise" deserved one read precisely BECAUSE it recurred identically -- pattern-matching a repeat as flake without reading one instance is how a real change wears a flake's costume. | LINE-GREP OF ^version OVER A MANIFEST MATCHES DEPENDENCY LINES: the authoritative version is what cargo RESOLVES, never what a grep of the toml returns. |
| ONE SHARED CONDVAR WAITED AGAINST PER-INSTANCE MUTEXES (AFT P1 conviction, latent since v0.50.0): the first waiter binds the condvar to its mutex; a second instance's distinct mutex panics pthread ("condition variable with two mutexes"). Trigger = any MULTI-INSTANCE burst on the wait path (mass teardowns), so the defect lived latent until an ENOSPC storm produced the shape -- ENOSPC was the exposure amplifier, not the cause, and both prime suspects (the new rework, the environment) were innocent. Audit form: every std Condvar gets ONE owning mutex, structurally paired (same struct, same slot); a condvar field beside a COLLECTION of mutexes is the signature. | THE SECOND CONVICTION RODE ALONG: an unbounded event drain holding shared state starved try-lock health reads for hours -- the Health-Path-Rule violated from the WORK side (insulated reads, unbounded holder). Bounded-per-lock-turn with carryover is the shape. Hours of "degraded" were a real defect wearing environmental noise's costume. |
| A FIELD REMOVAL IS A NARROWING ON THE CONSUMER even though it reads as simplification on the producer (CALLO's stop-before-deploy on the scheduled_tasks retirement): the OLD deployed parser REQUIRED the field, so every module rebuilt on the new crate would fail REGISTRATION at runtime after a green build -- the side that refuses (the running supervisor) learns first, so THE DAEMON DEPLOYS BEFORE ANY REBUILT MODULE. My failure: the constraint was NAMED in the PR review and description, then not EXECUTED -- documentation is not deployment ordering; a written constraint needs a sequenced action attached, or it is a prophecy. No future crate release can save deployed parsers (they are compiled) -- the new daemon was the only backward-tolerant artifact. | PREVENTION FROM BIRTH (SYNAPSE): collection-valued manifest fields get #[serde(default)] when first added -- then removal is a non-event on every deployed parser and the constraint never mints. |
| ONE FIELD RETIREMENT, THREE FAILURE SURFACES, THREE LATENCIES (the scheduled_tasks removal's full blast radius): version-dep siblings broke via LOCK INVALIDATION (--locked refusal, hours later), the deployed daemon via DEPLOY ORDER (runtime registration refusal, caught pre-fire), path-dep siblings via IMMEDIATE COMPILE PROPAGATION (no version gate; ALF's 9 sites broke the moment the commit landed, first detected as a mason's "pre-existing compile error" -- the path-dep tell: the break arrives wearing someone else's incident). Removal checklist: at wire-crate field retirement, enumerate consumers BY DEPENDENCY MODE (path / version / deployed-binary) and ping each class with its specific failure shape AT COMMIT TIME. |
| READABILITY IS THE COMMITMENT BOUNDARY (E2E's phase-split, finer than ruled): an idle peer has said nothing; a peer that stalls MID-FRAME has committed and broken its promise -- so the first-byte wait carries no deadline while intra-frame progress keeps one. Idle tolerance must never survive into a half-sent frame: blanket deadline removal buys the idle semantics and silently sells slowloris protection on the same stream. The pin-the-other-side arm (mid-frame stall still refused) is what forced a boundary instead of a deletion. | A PLATFORM STUB THAT OMITS A PRODUCTION MECHANISM makes the other platform's suite STRUCTURALLY incapable of testing it (macOS stub had NO deadline at all -- not slower, absent): one step worse than a slow machine hiding a race; local greens say nothing, CI is the only verifier, and the commit message states that rather than implying coverage. |
| THE TYPE ERASED THE ABSENCE, SO THE VALIDATOR WAS ASKED THE WRONG QUESTION (CEREB's session_kind default): unwrap_or(Primary) converts "missing" into an ordinary attested-looking value ONE LAYER ABOVE the check that refuses missing -- the durable validator refuses absence and is handed Some("primary"), so the comment's safety claim ("a defaulted kind never selects durable storage") holds at the layer that implements it and fails at the layer that serves it. The tell that closes the loop: NO FIXTURE CAN EXPRESS THE DEFECT, because the type cannot say "this was defaulted" -- when a safety property is untestable by construction, suspect provenance erasure upstream of the check. Fix shape: carry provenance in the type (attested flag beside the value, as the project id already does), refuse defaulted provenance exactly where privilege attaches, and make the previously-unwritable fixture the acceptance test. |
| MEASURING WHAT EXISTS AND CONCLUDING NOTHING ELSE IS REQUIRED (E2E, four same-direction failures in one night, first pre-ruling catch): every measurement was RIGHT and every inference from it wrong -- the anchors really held 2 fields; the conclusion "therefore the start record is just a cache" required them to hold all 10. The existence-proof cousin of the vacuous-fixture rule: what you measured being real says nothing about what the CONSUMER requires being covered. A collapse that does not collapse is worse than an open fork -- the fork advertises that a decision is needed. | "NO CI LEG" AND "A LEG THAT CANNOT FAIL ON THIS" produce the same silence and want different fixes (ASTRO: --locked absent made the committed lock DECORATIVE -- path deps resolve from disk, CI could not disagree with the workspace even in principle; fix = one flag, not a new leg). | REBUILD-LAG is the FOURTH failure surface of a field retirement (FUSI): a placed binary predating the removal runs fine while its source cannot compile -- invisible to acceptance loops (which execute placed binaries) until the next build. Dependency-mode enumeration: path / version / deployed-binary / rebuild-lag. |
| A ROUTINE ACTION THAT RESOLVES A SYMPTOM IS HARDER TO NOTICE THAN AN ALERT YOU IGNORE (ASTRO, refining the recurring-noise rule): CALLO's nine dismissals each left a residue of doubt; ASTRO's four lockfile reverts each ENDED IN A SUCCESSFUL CLEAN TREE, so no open-item feeling ever accumulated. The tell is not repetition -- it is HOLDING A HABITUAL REMEDIATION FOR SOMETHING NEVER DIAGNOSED. Audit your own routines: any cleanup you perform on cadence names a symptom you have not explained. | DECORATIVE VS CONSTRAINING LOCKS, the load-bearing distinction: a lock over path dependencies is UNENFORCEABLE by --locked-less CI (path deps resolve from disk regardless); a registry-only lock constrains resolution even without the flag. Sweep question is two-part: does CI pass --locked, AND does the repo hold path deps at all -- only the conjunction says whether the flag is load-bearing. |
| A GAUGE WHOSE INCREMENT SITES ARE ALL TEST-GATED publishes a structural zero in every release build (BROCA's projection_failures: quoted in deploy verifications, advertised as a health signal, could never move -- both increments were cfg(test)-gated and the counter was optimised out of the binary). Audit form: for any counter feeding health, verify one increment site compiles into the RELEASE profile -- nm for the symbol is the check, and a marker whose PRESENCE is the fix is the strongest marker class. | A SENTENCE CARRIED FORWARD FROM A PRIOR TURN IS AS UNVERIFIED AS A NUMBER TYPED FROM MEMORY, and reads more confidently because it worked last time (BROCA's "staging holds one candidate" -- true of the PREVIOUS supersede): reporting the state you intended, not the state you have; the listing you nearly skip is the catch. | THE DISCRIMINATOR LIVES ONE FIELD DEEPER THAN THE THING BEING COUNTED (version->source, leg->enforceability, name->step): the common repair for adjacent-question enumerations, cheap at the parse, silent toward confident wrongness after. |
| THE ADJACENT-QUESTION FAMILY'S CLOSING FORM (E2E, fourth instance): the tell is A QUERY PRODUCING A SINGLE VALUE PER ENTITY FOR A RELATION THAT IS NOT SINGLE-VALUED -- grep|head -1 over a lock with N instances per package reported an arbitrary row and DISCARDED THE EVIDENCE OF AMBIGUITY in the same expression that produced the answer. Defence: parse into records and PRINT THE COUNT, so N-per-entity is visible before any verdict derives. | TWO CORRECT MEASUREMENTS, ONE UNSUPPORTED JOIN: version staleness (lock) and dependency kind (cargo metadata) were each right; joining them assumed the stale version belonged to the path instance -- and the classifier PRINTED the refuting anomaly (the set's only mixed row), read as confirmation instead of as the question. Corroborated cases must not carry an uncorroborated one: two-corroboration covers only entities where behaviour is KNOWN. | EXACT VERSION PINS PROXYING FOR COMPILE-CHECKED PROPERTIES ARE PURE FRICTION (E2E's subc-client == pin): replace with a CONTRACT FLOOR (wire-version) once the structural assertions beside it are proven able to fail -- the pin then refuses only what the contract refuses. |
| POSITIVE CONTROLS MUST RUN IN THE SHIPPED CONFIGURATION (BROCA correcting my fence in #delivery-review): projection_failures' own test PASSED the whole time -- cfg(test) enabled the very increments it asserted on, so a control under test config certifies the configuration production never runs. Presence and reachability are separate proofs; a control proves both only when it executes the shipped path. | SELF-SKIPPING TESTS REPORT AS GREEN (ENGRAM's flag 8): a suite that skips itself when its runtime is absent prints "N ignored", exits 0, and lands in the gate list as a TRUE, GREEN, USELESS entry -- defeating both absence-flags and human skims. Parse the runner's own skip count from recorded gate bytes; flag skipped>0, hard-flag skipped==total. | CHAIR-TYPED ATTESTATIONS ARE WORKER REPORTS ONE LEVEL UP (BROCA -> AFT's upgrade): derive files_read from RENDER HISTORY (system-recorded, unforgeable by either party); the chair types only the genuine decision (accepted_on_flags). For report-only deliveries: claims_rederived = [claim -> command + falsifying-direction OUTPUT LINE] -- an anchor that matched nothing cannot fabricate the output, making it the only self-authenticating field a verification record carries. |
| A FILTER THAT SELECTS NOTHING READS AS A PASS (BROCA extending flag 8): `cargo test --test X nonexistent_name` exits 0 with "0 passed; 39 filtered out" -- zero tests executed, green gate line, and it is how five broken mutation verifications passed in one night. Rule: executed==0 in any recorded gate is NEVER evidence (hard-flag); skipped>0 or filtered>0 is a soft flag. The counts are already in the recorded bytes. | RENDER HISTORY PROVES SERVED, NOT READ (BROCA naming the limit of their own upgrade): system-recorded files_read kills the self-report layer but is the artifact-over-action distinction one level down -- a skimming chair produces a complete trail. Not fixable, so the SPEC SAYS IT in normative register; the field most likely to be over-trusted is the one that just fixed an over-trust. | FLAG 8 IS DIFFERENT IN KIND (ENGRAM): seven flags fire on ABSENCE; this one fires on a PRESENT, TRUE, GREEN entry whose every literal claim is correct and whose standard inference is false -- state it in the spec so a later pruner doesn't remove the odd one out. |
| DERIVE THE CONTROL FROM THE STRUCTURE, NEVER FROM A GUESS ABOUT NAMING (ENGRAM reproducing flag-8): their first control arm used a guessed substring filter and ALSO executed zero tests -- a two-arm proof whose arms were identical, caught only because agreement was impossible if the finding were real. --list first, then a real name. The room's thesis biting its own demonstration is the strongest form of the evidence. | READING IS NOT VERIFYING (ENGRAM + my #19, reached independently from opposite directions): bytes served AND read, inference still wrong -- their mutation-proof misread (narrowing proven load-bearing when the claim needed was the poison) happened with every file rendered. The spec's normative sentence carries this stronger form, not merely "attention is unrecorded". |
| THE ASSERTION MEASURED A QUANTITY THE DEFECT ALSO PRODUCES (CEREB's sourceRect proof): setWidth/setHeight scale the whole window to the requested size, so "a 32x32 rect yields a 32x32 image" passes with sourceRect DELETED -- size was a proxy the mechanism satisfied for free. Discriminate with an observation the defect CANNOT produce: two rects at different offsets (honoured -> different pixels; ignored -> byte-identical scaled whole). Sibling of the uniform-content arm: when evidence cannot tell (flat-colour window), REPORT rather than pass -- and prove non-uniformity before trusting any pixel comparison. |
| TWO SPECIFICITY AXES WIDEN IN MIRROR DIRECTIONS (CEREB's consent collision): narrowest-scope-wins ignores app-specificity; name-beats-wildcard-across-scopes lets a broad scope's named row override a narrow scope's wildcard ("class 1 everywhere for this agent" silently becoming class 2 on Chrome). Composition rule that kills both: specificity resolves WITHIN a scope only; ACROSS scopes explicit rows compose by MINIMUM; silence is transparent. The invariant to pin with a property test: effective authority never exceeds ANY explicit matching row at ANY scope -- one sentence, both collision directions, structurally closed. | A GATE'S PROMISE IS WORDED AS WHAT IT CAN BUILD: "no NEW action dispatches after human input returns" is committable; "instant stop" is a lying gauge (the window-server-accepted action resolves OutcomeUnknown). Idleness (and every consent predicate) is checked AT EACH DISPATCH, never at grant or sequence start. |
| AN UNIMPLEMENTABLE SAFETY PROMISE IS TRUST SPENT ON SOMETHING THAT FAILS EXACTLY WHEN IT MATTERS (CEREB on the class-3 stop): a user reads a stop button as a guarantee, so promising "instant stop" over a best-effort mechanism is worse than the usual lying gauge. Word gate promises as what the mechanism commits (no NEW dispatch), name the best-effort half, resolve the accepted-but-unfinished remainder as OutcomeUnknown. | CONSENT MUST NOT KEY ON A DIMENSION THE FROZEN ARTIFACT DOES NOT CARRY (CEREB's still-open catch): a resolver would DEFAULT the missing class per (action, delivery) pair -- the type-erased-absence defect at design scale. The artifact grows the dimension BEFORE the spec that keys on it fires. |
| MECHANISM DOES NOT DETERMINE DISRUPTION (CEREB's cross-OS survey: AXRaise is semantic in mechanism, disruptive in effect): class definitions must be EFFECT-worded with the global-resource list explicit (cursor, keyboard, focus, z-order); a "quiet" mechanism seizing z-order is a class-3 act. Corollary pin: RECLASSIFYING AN ACTION DOWNWARD IS A GRANT-WIDENING EVENT (a standing level-2 grant silently covers anything demoted from 3) -- downward moves carry addition ceremony, assignments record their evidence (measured / doc-derived), and freeze-time uncertainty resolves by MEASURING, not guessing-high-and-demoting. | COVERAGE IS NOT THE GOAL OF A CLOSED VOCABULARY; REASONED AUTHORITY IS (the OpaqueInvoke fork): an AT-SPI action name is application-chosen = attacker-chosen input on this threat model, and forwarding it under a grant written for known verbs destroys the property the closed list exists for. "Rejects valid actions" is the design working. Escape hatch if ever needed: per-invocation approval only, never grantable standing. |
| A PRIVILEGE LADDER IS ORDERED BY HOW FAR FROM THE CALLER'S INTENT THE EFFECT CAN LAND (CEREB's reframe of the consent classes): named element (exact) -> app's internal focus (app-scoped drift) -> system focus (global drift) -> seized shared resource. Addressability narrows as blast radius widens; DISRUPTION is a consequence of the ordering, not its axis -- which is why mechanism-worded classes failed (mechanism describes the sender's side; the ladder is about where effects land). The L2/L3 discriminator: a synthetic keystroke can land on an unintended control INSIDE the authorized app (internal focus moved between the informing read and the keystroke -- the staleness family within one process); a semantic press cannot, because it names its element. | A CONSERVATIVE DEFAULT IS A DEBT, NOT A RESTING STATE (demotion-ceremony corollary): paying it down later is a grant-widening event, so guess-high-fix-later is a scheduled ceremony, and MEASURED is the only resting state for a class assignment. |
| I MUTATION-PROVED A CODE THAT CANNOT ARRIVE (PLEX, implementing child_idle_evicted after the invisibility ruling): stopping one inference short (eviction is invisible -> therefore no refusal can carry it) and then FENCING the result is how a wrong thing acquires the appearance of rigour -- the mutation proved the CLASSIFIER, and no fence can prove the TRIGGER exists. Before fencing a handler, prove the input is producible; a handler for an unproducible input is dead vocabulary wearing a green test. | CALLERS MUST NOT CIRCUIT-BREAK ON A CODE THE PRODUCER ALREADY RETRY-DISCIPLINES (spawn_failed + cooldown probe): two breakers around one child convert self-healing outages into permanent suspensions. The producer publishes retry_after_ms so callers wait by NUMBER, not by hardcoded constant -- machine-readable backoff is the anti-stacking contract. |
| CI FINDINGS FROM AFT'S MEASUREMENT-FIRST PASS (19-26m -> 8m tests, 38m -> 14.6m release), fleet-relayed: measure per-job compile-vs-execution splits from 3 green runs BEFORE changing anything (both intuitive "free wins" were falsified by logs; the assumed-compile-bound lane was execution-bound). Build-once-run-sharded (nextest archive + partition) with INVENTORY IDENTITY proof (shard-sum == baseline, deliberate-duplicate non-vacuity break). Publish the EXACT binaries e2e tested (closes tested-vs-shipped). Release-lane cache keys hide PR-scoped gaps because releases are rare -- audit separately. workflow_dispatch validation mode that skips publish side effects. Absolute-time suites get honest declines from consolidation, reason recorded. | Two rig rules: never run permission/e2e suites from a /tmp worktree when the product exempts temp dirs from permission checks (31 false failures); `git merge main` into an ancestry-only (-s ours) ledger branch DESTROYS it by fast-forward -- detached worktrees + cherry-picks only. |
| STAGED-ARTIFACT MECHANISM'S TWO LOAD-BEARING DETAILS (CKCRED, learned the hard way): stage OUTSIDE cargo's target tree (a later cargo test --release recompiles over the signed artifact and silently invalidates the published sha), and the binary-path override REFUSES a bad path, never falls back (a typo quietly tests the cargo-built binary and reports exactly the green the caller hoped for). | SUSPICIOUSLY FAST IS A PROMPT, NOT A COMPLIMENT: a 2-minute pipeline over 341 tests earned a thoroughness check (exact inventory count + anti-masking guard) before being believed. Under OS-conditional jobs, WINDOWS-GREEN AND UBUNTU-GREEN ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS -- "CI green" is a per-lane fact wearing a single checkmark; read it per lane or misread it once. | A SUITE MOVED OFF EVERY-PUSH NEEDS AN ABSENCE ALARM (SYNAPSE's nightly relocation): scheduled-fail-loud if no green within N days -- a relocated suite's silent death is the alarm-without-a-schedule class. |
| RUN HISTORY IS A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT FROM RUN DURATION (PLEX's sweep return: went in to measure speed, found FOUR unnoticed red runs on main): timing one green run measures cleanly and learns nothing -- pull the last N runs' HISTORY first, then split the greens. A green LOCAL gate is not a green CI run on a path-dep repo for STRUCTURAL reasons (CI checks out siblings at default branches; the local tree has whatever was pulled) -- two worlds wearing one green; query CI by sha for your OWN pushes. | I GENERALISED A CONTENTION ARTIFACT INTO A FACT ABOUT THE CODEBASE (FUSI: "17m44s suite" was load 8-124 from four seats' builds; CI does the workspace in 88s): a measurement taken under known contention, not carried forward WITH its contention, becomes a false property and then a habit. The ladder is a local convenience; CI is the gate, and it is cheap. | Do-nothing-on-measurement verdicts (FUSI 1.9m, CKCRED 2m, PLEX 5-6m vs AFT's 19-26m): the relay's mechanisms are for the 20-minute class; shard-sum invariants maintained forever against a 2-minute saving is negative yield. |
| THE FIFTH FAILURE SURFACE: WORKING-TREE COUPLING (FUSI + CKTUI, same hour): path deps resolve to a DIRECTORY, not a revision -- a consumer compiles the producer's UNCOMMITTED edits, fails in the producer's files with the consumer's own change unverified, and neither party did anything (one was editing, one was building). Invisible to both; no lockfile records what was compiled. Discriminator: when a path-dep build fails inside a sibling repo, check git status THERE before believing the error -- dirty means wait, clean means real. Dependency-mode enumeration: path / version / deployed-binary / rebuild-lag / working-tree. CI is the only build seeing a consistent multi-repo snapshot. | A RULE FIRES AT A MOMENT (CALLO): both announcement misses were the moment passing unnoticed, not the rule forgotten -- rules that fire at moments need INTERRUPTS, not intention (check-wire-field-announcement.sh is commit-time's; the brief-time one is each seat's own). | A COMPLETE SIGNAL READ AS TRUNCATED (CALLO's three false corrections from one E0063): one error IS the normal shape for one bad site; extrapolating "the compiler must have stopped early" built three fixes for defects that did not exist -- the compiler-output sibling of the carried-forward sentence. | XCTest prints "Executed 0 tests, with 0 failures" for an unwired swift-testing target (CKIOS): parse the runner's own positive summary and treat its ABSENCE as an error -- flag-8's Xcode instance; a gate that cannot distinguish all-green from nothing-ran is worse than none. | A PERMISSION TEST THAT SETS THE WRONG MODE FIRST and asserts correction is immune to environment in both directions (PLEX); create-and-assert is vacuous exactly where temp dirs are exempt. |
| START_PAUSED CONVERTS A BOUNDED WAIT INTO AN UNBOUNDED SPIN (BROCA's failed fix): tokio auto-advance grants every re-armed timer instantly, so a loop that re-arms under a 30s budget spins forever under paused time -- the obvious test speedup turns a slow test into a hanging one (30s -> CI job timeout). Real fix is an injectable budget run in milliseconds of REAL time; that is a production-signature change deserving its own round. Diagnostic tell that found it: RANK TESTS BY THE RUNNER'S OWN TIMING AND LOOK FOR ROUND CONSTANTS -- 30.03s is a timer, not work. | A DECLINE RECORDS ITS REVERSAL CONDITION (BROCA: "if integration time passes ~5 minutes, shard") -- a decline without its re-open input hardens into a rule after the input changes. |
| QUARANTINE PRESERVES CONTENT AND EXPOSURE (CKTUI's #7 find): a rename-aside inherits the OLD file's mode, so quarantining a pre-sealing 0644 index preserved user prompt text world-readable -- the repair path for legacy machines is exactly the path carrying the legacy exposure. Standing rule (4 instances in one crate): sealing on a DURABLE PATH repairs on every write, never at creation -- create-time modes cannot reach existing files, and fresh machines pass every check while the affected population is precisely the machines with history. | A SKIP GATING A WHOLE TEST hollows the arm that could discriminate: split the skip to the genuinely-indeterminate arm and make the substantive arm unskippable (pre-create at explicit WRONG mode; only real tightening passes on any umask). | THE INSTRUMENT BUILT TO MAKE SILENCE VISIBLE WAS SILENT: skipped() printed to stdout, which cargo CAPTURES for passing tests -- grep-zero over a run that definitely skips proved it; fix by structure (unskippable arm), not louder output, because visibility fixes rot. |
| A FROZEN CONTRACT WITH NO ENFORCEMENT IS DECORATIVE, and its decorativeness is invisible precisely because the file looks authoritative (CEREB: artifact declares a 3-field closed response, wire serves 4, validate_closed_schema checks the SCHEMA is well-formed and never that any reply conforms) -- schema validation and conformance validation are different questions wearing one function name; every frozen result_schema needs a divergent-field-reddens-a-named-test mutation or the freeze governs nothing. | VERIFICATION IS NOT A QUERY (CEREB, from the axi source-check): effect verification answers DID-WHAT-I-EXPECTED-HAPPEN (yes/no, reduces uncertainty); a post-action query answers WHAT-IS-THERE-NOW (the data the next action needs) -- given only the first, a separate snapshot round trip is still mandatory, so verification does not reduce turns. Summaries conflate them; only reading the return payload distinguishes them. | READING-IS-NOT-VERIFYING BITES ITS OWN ENFORCERS: the discipline is not holding the rule continuously but CHECKING AT THE MOMENT A CLAIM BECOMES LOAD-BEARING -- CEREB applied the rule to my relay and broke it in the same afternoon on a scanned-not-read artifact claim ("freezes requests only"), caught when a different reason forced the read. |
| A CONFLICTED PR GETS NO ACTIONS RUN AT ALL (no merge ref -> no pull_request suite, no "skipped" marker, nothing to find): reads exactly like an event-delivery failure, and I burned three retrigger probes (reopen, empty commit, fresh twin PR) before checking `mergeable: CONFLICTING`. When CI seems to silently not fire on a PR: CHECK MERGEABILITY FIRST -- it is one field, and every retrigger against a conflicted PR is wasted. Corollary for twin-PR workflows over moving masters: a twin can be born mergeable and turn conflicted when the base moves; the twin's silence dates from the base commit that conflicted it, not from any event. |
| SPLIT EXECUTION INTO WORK AND WAITING BEFORE CHOOSING A CI MECHANISM (QTA, upgrading the relay's step 1): every mechanism on the ranked list moves WORK around and none removes a WAIT -- sharding a 60s elapsed-time test is two runners each waiting 60s. A 60.4s test is a production cadence (BASE_INTERVAL) wearing a test's name. | A FASTER SUITE THAT PROVES SOMETHING ELSE IS NOT A FASTER SUITE (QTA's refusal of the test-only interval override): the fenced relationship FRESH_HORIZON > BASE_INTERVAL + FETCH_DEADLINE inverts under a 1s test interval, so the sped-up test passes under a timing configuration production never runs while claiming to verify timing-dependent fail-closed behaviour. Same class as start_paused: obvious speedups of WAITING-shaped tests convert correctness into speed. | THE SIZE GATE, stated as arithmetic: adoption cost (archives, partitioning, shard-sum proofs) is real and PERMANENT; benefit is bounded by the work half of the measured path. Sweep evidence: 8 audited, 6 do-nothing, the only two movers had 19+ minute paths. |
| THE TRAJECTORY SHAPE DIAGNOSES WHERE THE RULINGS LIVE (ALF's section-form sibling of the clarify-fold defect): a spec campaign whose blocking count FALLS round-over-round has a fold consuming its rulings; one that PLATEAUS while panels re-flag the same items has rulings parked somewhere the fold has no duty to merge (clarify log, side section). Pre-fire check: rulings are IN normative section text. Post-cap check: a flat trajectory's first suspect is a parked ruling, not panel quality. |
| FIRST LIVE PUBLISH-WHAT-YOU-TESTED RELEASE (AFT v0.51.0): the placed production binary IS the exact asset the release run's macOS-native e2e suite exercised -- the tested-vs-shipped gap closed by PIPELINE rather than by hand-ritual (sha of the published asset == sha the e2e job tested, verified at placement). Reference instance for the fleet-standard goal; the hand-ritual (stage-sign, marker differential, inode verify) remains the placement-side half. |
| A CAP THAT OUTLIVES ITS JUSTIFICATION MISLEADS WHOEVER READS IT NEXT (CKIOS retracting their own 47,613 six hours after arguing it in): a limit that CITES its reason in the rules block is retractable the day the reason dies -- one contract line instead of a migration; an uncited limit becomes transport folklore enforced long after its physics are gone. Sibling of declines-carry-reversal-conditions, at contract scale: write the justification WHERE the limit lives. |
| AN ARTIFACT THAT CANNOT BE RE-DERIVED FROM ITS OWN TAG IS UNPLACEABLE even when its bytes are fine (BROCA superseding v0.3.53): the protocol moved under the tag (fields became required), so a fresh build of the tag no longer compiles -- and re-verification-under-incident is exactly when the rebuild is needed and impossible. Placement candidates must rebuild from their own tag at placement time, not just at cut time. Paired discipline: BROCA CHECKED the stale artifact's actual risk instead of assuming it (absent field defaults to the same value -> hazard unreal), so the supersede stands on reproducibility alone -- no speculative fix shipped. | TAKING A SERDE DEFAULT IN A CONTRACT IS LETTING THE COMPILER PICK YOUR SEMANTICS (BROCA): defaults exist for WIRE COMPATIBILITY (old binaries, absent fields); a CURRENT module's manifest DECLARES its values -- same value, different standing, because a manifest is a contract speaking for the module. |
| A PRECONDITION THAT IS ALWAYS FALSE LOOKS IDENTICAL TO ONE THAT IS NEVER MET (CKCRED, on rung-3 activation): a gate written loosely ("no GitHub credential anywhere") never activates and silently becomes a permanent no-op -- the worst outcome, because a parked mechanism reads as a working fence. Preconditions must be CHECKABLE, TERMINATE, and NAME THE ACTUAL HAZARD (ambient env credentials, not custodied handles) -- and the refusal should log WHICH item blocked activation so a permanently-parked gate is diagnosable in one read. | A SCOPED CREDENTIAL BEATS AN AGREEING CHECK (CKCRED's permissions-scoped installation tokens): a manifest tier + enumeration test is reviewable policy; a credential minted BELOW the needed permission is arithmetic -- adding merge_pr to the weak tier still fails at GitHub with 403 because the token in hand was never able to merge. Where a provider supports scoping-below-grant, make the lowest gate physical. |
| A GATE POSITIONED WHERE IT CANNOT DO WORK, two instances from the identity room: (a) CKCRED's human-gated-by-construction -- GitHub App creation rides a browser click, so adding a step-up attestation there DUPLICATES A HUMAN and gates nothing (check what already gates a path before adding a gate); (b) AFT's release-gate confession -- a version-line check positioned where it could only fail AFTER crates published is a gate whose failure is invisible until too late. Siblings of the always-false precondition: all three are gates that look like fences and refuse nothing. | GRANULARITY LIMITS GO IN THE DESIGN DOC BESIDE THE MECHANISM (PLEX verifying scoped tokens at source): GitHub's permissions cut does not match our tier cut (pull_requests:write covers BOTH pr-comment and merge), so the credential floor is physical for issue ops and policy-only for the PR pair -- oversold floors are found by the next incident, stated limits by the next reader. |
| THE FENCE DID NOT REJECT A CORRECT MIGRATION, IT EXPOSED AN INCORRECT ONE (ALF's ask-UX deploy, closing the prefrontal-core P1): a shipped backfill nulled resolution stamps on 843 answered asks -- re-arming them all into a redelivery storm -- and the v024 campaign-approval immutability trigger aborted the migration at boot with zero data damage. The crash-loop READ as deployment friction; it was the fence's one production firing doing exactly its job. Distinction to keep: a fail-closed fence that fires on a wrong change is not friction, and the wrongness of the change is independent of the fence that caught it. |
| A GRANT WRITTEN TO A FIELD NOBODY READS IS THE ALWAYS-FALSE PRECONDITION WEARING A SUCCESS MESSAGE (my fed-profile miss, caught by CKIOS's "both peers still hold 20 ops"): I appended ops to a key named allowed_ops, verified the KEY WAS PRESENT IN THE FILE, restarted the consumer, and reported the legs landed -- but the schema's real grant list is expose:[{module,operation}], so the edit was load-free.
